decisions.reason: Selecting a new authoritative manuscript file does not change the chapter illustration choices, placement, sizing, or quality requirements.
The selected source file does not necessarily change the copyediting goal or the previously approved passages.
The manuscript source-file designation does not alter the KDP keyword deliverable, its format, or its intended use.
Choosing the authoritative manuscript file does not change the agreed KDP upload guidance or troubleshooting assistance.
The file designation does not modify the requirement to italicize the Mama's Hot Take callout text.
Using the designated manuscript file does not change the trim size, publication format, paragraph spacing, or page-density decisions.
The source-file selection does not itself change the copyright-page alignment, email inclusion, or planned website inclusion.
The authoritative-file change does not alter the established Chapter 12 subtitle, body-text hierarchy, or capitalization requirements.
The file designation does not resolve or modify the outstanding uncertainty about the interior title-page layout.
Selecting the manuscript source file does not change the requirement to prepare back matter and author copy.
The designated manuscript file does not change the separate paperback cover artifact, dimensions, content, or editorial-review requirements.
